Traits.name: Umbral Veil
Traits.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the stalker has the Invisible condition.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The stalker makes two Shadow Claw attacks.

Actions.name: Shadow Claw
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage.

Actions.name: Ambush Pounce
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 13, one creature within 60 feet. *Failure:* 21 (6d6) Psychic damage. *Success:* Half damage.
